hypothesis: Observed large forced long selling followed by positive as-of spot absorption adds information about the next 60-minute fully funded BTC spot long movement after costs.
instrument: OKX BTC-USDT spot, fully funded long/flat
confirmation: Both 5m and 15m source-quality-gated spot buy-minus-sell quote-flow imbalances positive
controls: Same eligible forced-selling episodes without spot filter
Price-momentum-only on the same eligible episodes
cost_policy: Document actual fees when supplied; otherwise freeze explicit fee scenarios before the trial. Include observed bid/ask, slippage, displayed size and a stress scenario. No assumed maker fills.
source_gate: Review the data pilot's real live-event latency, explicit liquidation information timestamps, matched REST/WS metadata cases, source completeness assumptions, provider limits and event yield. A fast fill notification without liquidation metadata does not pass.
trial_gate: Only start after a reviewed source-gate document and a separate frozen protocol/code/cohort. No retrospective decisions or automatic enabling from pilot metrics.
review_gate: At least 14 days and 100 non-overlapping completed episodes across days; review paired net benefit, uncertainty, costs, concentration and missing/censored outcomes. This is permission for analysis, never automatic orders.
